_metadata.name: PAMF Hospitalist Discharge Summary (Template B)
_metadata.style: PAMF Hospitalist format — terse and problem-based: diagnoses up top, a one-liner narrative course, labs/imaging/procedures/consults folded into one 'Significant Findings, Studies, Procedures' section, dispo and follow-up before findings, and a below-the-line block (vitals/exam, CURES attestation, MDM statement, PAMF Hospitalist sign-off) not copied into PAMF Epic.
_metadata.based_on: PAMF Hospitalist 'Discharge Summary' Epic template (Template contents (1).pdf)
_metadata.content_parity_note: Captures the SAME note-derived clinical facts as template_A — only section/field NAMING, grouping, ordering, and institution-specific STATIC boilerplate differ. Static boilerplate carries no note-derived clinical content, so it does not break content parity. Do not add or remove note-derived content categories relative to template_A.
_metadata.parity_placement_note: The PAMF shell has no standalone Past Medical History or Patient Education section, but parity requires those note-derived facts to appear in B. PMHx sits just after the Summary (where PAMF's one-liner references it) and patient education/warning signs are folded into Additional Discharge Instructions, so the sections the PDF DOES show stay in PDF order.
_metadata.null_convention: Use JSON null (not 'Not provided') for any field absent from the source note.
_metadata.static_convention: A field with a 'static' key is fixed institutional boilerplate emitted verbatim for every note; it is not drawn from and does not depend on the source note.
_metadata.catch_all: additional_information.clinical_details holds any specialty-specific or uncategorized clinical information so nothing is dropped.

attending_at_discharge.description: Attending physician at time of discharge

brief_hpi.description: Brief HPI per admission H&P. Keep concise; preserve dates and values.
brief_hpi.example: 64yo M with 3 days of productive cough and dyspnea...

summary_of_hospital_course.description: One-liner plus brief problem-based course. Frame as '[age] [sex] with [PMHx], admitted for [reason], found to have [findings]'. Keep concise; avoid repeating the full H&P but preserve clinical specifics.

narrative_summary.description: One-liner narrative (age/sex, PMHx, reason for admission, key findings) plus brief course
narrative_summary.example: 64yo M with HTN/COPD admitted for pneumonia, treated with antibiotics, improved.

complications.description: Complications during the stay. Empty array if none.

past_medical_history.description: PMHx referenced by the summary one-liner (PAMF folds this into the narrative; kept structured here for parity).

social_history.description: Smoking, alcohol, drugs, living situation, occupation

mandatory_hf_ami_documentation.display_name: Mandatory Documentation for Heart Failure or Acute Myocardial Infarction
mandatory_hf_ami_documentation.description: PAMF static quality-documentation block for HF/AMI.

quality_measures.static: AMI/HF quality measures documented per the AMI or HF Quality smartset when applicable.
quality_measures.description: PAMF static HF/AMI mandatory documentation attestation.

disposition.description: Discharge destination and support (home vs SNF, etc.).

support_services.description: Home health, VNA, PT/OT, case management

advance_directives.description: Proxy, living will, POLST if documented

appointments.description: Each entry has date, time, provider, department, phone.

recommendations.description: Follow-up recommendations (e.g., see PCP in 1-2 weeks)

significant_findings_studies_procedures.description: Final labs, imaging, studies, procedures, consults, and pending labs folded into one section (insert FINAL labs, imaging, echo, significant labs).

labs.description: Significant lab values as labeled key-value pairs with dates

other_studies.description: EKG, echo, PFTs, microbiology, or other studies

procedures.description: Procedures with dates. Each entry has date, description, findings.

consultants.description: Consulting services. Each entry has service, reason, key_recommendations.

pending_labs.description: Tests ordered but not resulted at discharge. Each entry has test, ordered_date, expected_location, action_needed.

medications.description: Each entry has name, dose, route, frequency, indication.

additional_discharge_instructions.description: Care instructions, patient education, and warning signs at discharge.

monitoring.description: What to watch for at home
monitoring.example: Return if fever or worsening dyspnea

condition_and_exam_at_discharge.description: Below-the-line documentation (not copied into PAMF Epic): discharge vitals and exam.

do_not_copy_separator.static: ——————— do not copy info below this line into PAMF Epic ———————

vital_signs.example: BP 124/78, HR 72, RR 16, afebrile, SpO2 96% RA

attestation.static: The CURES database was reviewed before prescribing any opiates for this patient.

attending_sign_off.description: PAMF static sign-off and medical-decision-making statement.

medical_decision_making.static: Medical decision making: >50% of the encounter spent counseling patient and family on lab/imaging results, medication changes/monitoring, and discharge plans. Coordinated with RN and case management regarding discharge plans; PAMF Epic updated and PCP notified.

additional_information.description: Catch-all for anything not captured above.

clinical_details.description: Flexible labeled key-value pairs for any specialty-specific or uncategorized clinical information. Add whatever keys are relevant — do not omit information just because it lacks a dedicated field.
